# Physics 3D API

<div class="doc-meta"><span class="doc-badge">Reference</span> Generated from <code>src/caffeine/script/api/physics3d.json</code></div>

Ray queries and forces on the Bullet 3D world. Everything is a safe no-op (false or nil) when the host runs without 3D physics. Forces and velocity only affect dynamic bodies.

<!-- Generated by caffeine-website/scripts/generate-api-pages.py. Edit the engine JSON instead. -->

## Functions

### `caffeine.physics3d.isAvailable`

`isAvailable() -> boolean`

Tells whether 3D physics can be used at all.

**Returns:** `boolean` — true when a 3D physics world is attached and the Bullet backend is built in.

**Example**

```lua
if not caffeine.physics3d.isAvailable() then caffeine.debug.warn("no 3D physics") end
```

### `caffeine.physics3d.setGravity`

`setGravity(x, y, z)`

Sets the gravity vector in metres per second squared (default 0, -9.81, 0).

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | X component. |
| `y` | number | Y component. |
| `z` | number | Z component. |

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.physics3d.setGravity(0, -3.7, 0) -- Mars
```

### `caffeine.physics3d.setSurfaceCombine`

`setSurfaceCombine(mode) -> boolean`

Chooses how the two surfaces of a contact are merged. The default blend makes a bouncy ball bounce on any floor; use "product" for scenes tuned against the old rule.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | "blend" (default): friction is the geometric mean of the two surfaces and restitution the larger. "product": both are multiplied, Bullet's own rule. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — false for an unknown mode or when 3D physics is not available.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.physics3d.setSurfaceCombine("product")
```

### `caffeine.physics3d.raycast`

`raycast(ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, maxDistance) -> table | nil`

Casts a ray and returns the first solid body it hits, with the hit point and surface normal.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ox, oy, oz` | number | Ray origin in world space. |
| `dx, dy, dz` | number | Direction; it does not need to be normalised. |
| `maxDistance` | number | Maximum length in metres. |

**Returns:** `table | nil` — { entity, x, y, z, nx, ny, nz, distance } for the nearest body hit, or nil. Triggers are ignored.

**Example**

```lua
local hit = caffeine.physics3d.raycast(0, 10, 0, 0, -1, 0, 100)
if hit then caffeine.debug.log(hit.entity .. " at " .. hit.distance) end
```

### `caffeine.physics3d.addForce`

`addForce(entity, x, y, z) -> boolean`

Applies a force (newtons) at the centre of mass. A force holds for the frame it is called in, like holding a key: call it every frame while the push should last. The push is the same at any frame rate.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | A body with a RigidBody3D and Collider3D. |
| `x` | number | X component. |
| `y` | number | Y component. |
| `z` | number | Z component. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — false for an unknown or non-dynamic body.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.physics3d.addForce(eid, 0, 50, 0)
```

### `caffeine.physics3d.addImpulse`

`addImpulse(entity, x, y, z) -> boolean`

Applies an instant change of momentum (newton-seconds) at the centre of mass, e.g. a jump.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | A body with a RigidBody3D and Collider3D. |
| `x` | number | X component. |
| `y` | number | Y component. |
| `z` | number | Z component. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — false for an unknown or non-dynamic body.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.physics3d.addImpulse(eid, 0, 6, 0)
```

### `caffeine.physics3d.setVelocity`

`setVelocity(entity, x, y, z) -> boolean`

Sets the linear velocity in metres per second.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | A body with a RigidBody3D and Collider3D. |
| `x` | number | X component. |
| `y` | number | Y component. |
| `z` | number | Z component. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — false for an unknown or non-dynamic body.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.physics3d.setVelocity(eid, 4, 0, 0)
```

### `caffeine.physics3d.velocity`

`velocity(entity) -> table | nil`

Reads the linear velocity of a body.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | A body with a RigidBody3D and Collider3D. |

**Returns:** `table | nil` — { x, y, z } in metres per second, or nil for an unknown or non-dynamic body.

**Example**

```lua
local v = caffeine.physics3d.velocity(eid)
```
